requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement text is syntactically clear but semantically mixes two independent operations (adding a system and allowing a subscription). Per business rule BR-01 and Pohl §25.2, this has been decomposed into two separate atomic requirements: one functional requirement for the system addition and one functional requirement for the subscription allowance.
